Committee: Transportation, Utilities and Infrastructure
Sponsor: South
Analyst: John Friedenreich
Date: 02/03/2022
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 107 as introduced would allow the Alabama Department of Transportation to adjust the timing of payments on obligations issued by the Alabama Federal Aid Highway Finance Authority to no later than the date for payment of the principal and interest on obligations that mature.
This bill will not otherwise affect state or local funding.
Lynn Greer, Chair
Transportation, Utilities and Infrastructure

FISCAL NOTE
